headline: Maui County Liquor Control Commission

meeting.summary: The department said no rule or law limits a class 5 dispenser license to one category.
meeting.recap: The department said no rule or law limits a class 5 dispenser license to one category.[[0:07:31]] A motion stated that class 5 licenses are not limited to one category.[[0:25:19]] The commission unanimously approved a liquor license for a sport fishing company's tour boat.[[0:59:51]] The commission unanimously approved the Unicorn Tours of Hawaiʻi liquor license.[[1:18:00]] A commissioner said the wildfire relocation rule's wording, 'destroyed or rendered inoperable,' is too narrow.[[1:33:35]] Commissioners found a sixth provision they had added was missing.[[1:36:55]] The commission unanimously voted to defer the emergency rule item.[[1:39:24]] The commission went into executive session (a closed-door discussion) on two 2023 files.[[1:39:54]]
decided: The commission approved the agenda unanimously.
The commission approved the September 11, 2024 minutes unanimously.
The commission confirmed the general licensing matters unanimously.
The commission approved Unicorn Tours of Hawaiʻi's tour vessel liquor license.
The commission voted to go into executive session with its attorney on two 2023 files.
The commission voted to adjourn at 11:37.
meeting.next: The chair suggested deferring the emergency rule to next month to see why a provision was missing. The attorney said he may send a letter asking for the question of dropping a license category to come before the commission. The department said it is in the process of revamping its existing regulations.
